Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.

Adoption on Second Reading of Ordinance 18-729, Adding a New Chapter 8.18 of Title 8 of the City's Municipal Code Related to Mandatory Commercial and Multi-Family Residential Recycling, and Ordinance 18-730, Adding a New Chapter 8.14 of Title 8 of the City's Municipal Code Related to Construction and Demolition Waste Management; and Adoption of Resolution R18-17 Adding New Fees of the Public Works Department
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council adopt upon second reading Ordinance 18-729, adding a new Chapter 8.18 of Title 8 of the City's Municipal Code related to mandatory commercial and multi-family residential recycling, and Ordinance 18-730, adding a new Chapter 8.14 of Title 8 of the City's Municipal Code related to C&D WMP processing; and adopt Resolution R18-17 adding new fees of the Public Works Department for C&D WMP processing.

Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council adopt upon second reading Ordinance 18-728; an Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Palos Verdes Estates amending Chapter 18.50 to Title 18 of the Palos Verdes Estates Municipal Code regarding the Water Efficient Landscape Ordinance for the City.

PUBLIC HEARINGS/ORDINANCE(S)
All persons addressing the City Council during public hearings shall be limited to three (3) minutes for comment, except for an Appellant/Applicant, which shall be provided five (5) minutes for presentation and rebuttal.
7.
Annual Protest Hearing of the City Council of the City of Palos Verdes Estates Declaring that Weeds, Brush, Rubbish and Refuse Upon or in Front of Specified Properties in the City are a Seasonal and Recurrent Public Nuisance, and Declaring its Intention for the Abatement Thereof
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council conduct a public hearing in accordance with Resolution R18-14 for unimproved properties, and at the conclusion of the hearing, adjust the list according to the protests heard and adopt a minute resolution directing the County Agricultural Commissioner Office (CACO) to inspect and abate weeds, brush, rubbish, and refuse as necessary on unimproved lots contained in the adjusted list. It is also recommended that the City Council conduct a public hearing in accordance with Resolution R18-15 for improved properties, and direct the Los Angeles County Fire Department (LACFD) to inspect all improved properties before affirmation of the final list.

Discussion of Discontinuing Prior Authorizations Associated with No Fee View Related Tree Trimming Permits
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council determine that prior no fee view related permit authorizations be invalid upon the March 12, 2018 effective date of the updated fee schedule, and that future Parklands Committee applications for view related tree trimming will be subject to a tree trimming fee.
